analysis.title: US Market Intell Morning Briefing, October 28, 2026
key_insights: Futures are flat with Tech leading ahead of the 2pm ET FOMC decision. The market expects a hawkish hold. The 10Y yield is 5.011% and the VIX is 17.58. WTI is up 218bps at $102.08.
Memory is the lead equity story. DRAM is +4.1% pre-market after Hynix earnings, and the stock gained 10.9%, which lifted Kospi more than 5%. DRAM is +10.2% over the last 3 sessions and Semis +6.9%.

JPM says it likes a barbell of Tech and Cyclicals to lead the next leg higher. It sees positive seasonality after the midterm elections. The stated risk is Middle East escalation that targets energy infrastructure.

TMT trader Brian Heavey says some hurdles to the AI picks-and-shovels trade are clearing. Financing was the main pressure last week. META is raising $97.5B ($60B via ATM from January), SPCX has a $40B GPU equipment deal, and AVGO has a $63B SPV for custom chips for a leading frontier lab. Semis, optical and hardware are outperforming. Re-risking is still tentative and volumes are light.

Heavey says GOOG is being used as a source of funds, and another negative third-party check ahead of earnings points to a Search miss. He thinks META is much higher over a longer duration despite convert pressure of about 6-7m shares.

Refiners had their largest drawdown since August (-2z), the largest decline in the refining index since May 2022 excluding Liberation Day, and about $35bn of combined market cap was lost. BBG estimates about 31mm shares will trade, which would be the 3rd highest volume day of the year.

Brendan Henrici's reasons for the refiner selloff: the gas crack move is unwinding, Ukraine has not hit Russian energy infrastructure since 10/18, the end of Russia's harvest season frees up supply for export, CTA signals for diesel and gasoil were firmly long, and there is angst before the VLO print.

Factor specialist Manish Sinha says the 'junk' factor is rallying aggressively and Quality (JPQPURE) was down 2Z at one point. He suggests shorting junk or adding hedges. He would buy Momentum/Alpha (JPMPURE) and hedge via Beta (JPBPURE) short. He sees the market pricing a dovish Fed, geopolitical resolution and an AI capex upcycle without funding needs, and calls that combination low-probability.

Feroli expects the Fed to hold with two hawkish dissents from Hammack and Logan, and sees a risk that Kashkari also dissents. He expects the statement to say policy 'will deliver a timely return to price stability'.

Feroli says Chair Warsh must explain why the committee hiked after a two-tenths core PCE print in September but is holding after an expected three-tenths print. He sees the committee as biased to hike but wanting time to observe the effect of last month's hike.

JPM Market Intel says Fed-driven volatility may extend into next week. The focus is the December meeting and 2027 path after the hawkish September inflation print, and whether emerging AI concerns shape the Fed's growth or inflation assessment.
JPM economists expect fed funds to go from 4.00% to 4.25% in December and then hold. The 10Y is near its ~5.00% expectation.

JPM equity strategy says higher rates should not derail equities given the earnings anchor. A shallow hiking cycle is manageable, while four to five hikes would create more downside and is not the base case. History suggests equities can withstand a 10Y yield near 5.5-6.0% if earnings hold.

Bear steepeners have favored Cyclicals such as Energy and Financials, and bear flatteners have favored Technology. Bond proxies and long-duration sectors outside Technology are most exposed. The base case favors Growth and Quality Growth and large-caps over small-caps.
JPM introduced three thematic baskets: higher rates (JPRHIRTB), lower rates (JPRLORTB) and rate-agnostic (JPRAGRTB).

US Market Intel remains Tactically Bullish. SPX lost 2.4% over two weeks, and flash PMIs point to about 5% annualized real growth. About a quarter of the SPX has reported with no dips to forecasts of ~13% revenue growth, ~30% EPS growth and ~15% margins. Positioning has not fully washed out despite fear sentiment.

Last week the Recession L/S (JPRECES) and Stagflation L/S (JP9STAGP) baskets returned 3.4% and 1.5%. Oil rose for the 4th consecutive week. Trump is nearing a decision on Iran between negotiation and continued attacks as a third aircraft carrier nears the region. If he returns to negotiation, JPM expects a broad rally led by Tech and Cyclicals ex-Energy.
The Monetization Menu adds hedges via longs in oil and Energy equities and long vol. The prior menu favored Tech, Financials and Retailers, with Brazil and Japan internationally.

Nate Silver's analysis found polls did not underestimate Republicans in the 2018 and 2022 midterms. The average polling error was 0 points in 2018, and polls underestimated Democrats by 0.3 points in 2022.

market_movers.rationale: JPM TMT Trading thinks the stock is much higher if held with duration. It is holding despite convert pressure and the $97.5B raise.
The stock is being used as a source of funds, and another negative third-party check points to a Search miss ahead of earnings.

sector_views.rationale: Tactically bullish barbell with Cyclicals. Semis and optical are better to buy, and bear flatteners have historically favored Tech.
Cyclicals ex-Energy would lead a rally if the Iran situation moves to negotiation. Bear steepeners favor Energy and Financials.
Largest drawdown for the refining index since May 2022 excluding Liberation Day, with about $35bn of market cap lost.
JPM remains constructive on Financials, which benefit from higher rates and have limited direct AI exposure.
These are the most negatively exposed to higher rates.

earnings_insights: Hynix earnings (reported 10/27-28) lifted the stock 10.9% and Kospi more than 5%.
JPM Equity Strategy: about a quarter of the SPX has reported, with no dips to pre-season forecasts of ~13% revenue growth, ~30% EPS growth and ~15% margins (estimates).

Earnings due 10/28 after the close include MSFT, GOOGL, META-adjacent names, KLAC, EBAY, F, FDX, CMG, NOW, EQIX and TMUS. Before the open: GEV, VRT, BSX, ADP, OTIS and PSX. GOOGL has a negative third-party check pointing to a Search miss.
Refiner angst ahead of the VLO print after very high expectations, per Henrici.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Consensus expects a hold with a hawkish bias. Feroli expects two hawkish dissents (Hammack, Logan).

macro_indicators.reading: 4.00% to 4.25% in December, then on hold
macro_indicators.interpretation: JPM economists expect a shallow hiking cycle.
Yields are around the ~5.00% near-term expectation and forming new ranges at higher levels.
Per Feroli, the committee hiked after this two-tenths print.
The expected three-tenths outturn is due 10/29, and the committee is holding ahead of it.
The second consecutive month pointing to above-trend growth.
If earnings projections are met, equities can withstand a 10Y yield in this range.
Energy leads commodities, and oil has risen four consecutive weeks.

risk_factors: Middle East escalation that targets energy infrastructure.
A hawkish Fed surprise or an unexplained hold before the midterms.
Abrupt, volatile bond selloff or weaker earnings growth.
A broader hiking cycle of four to five hikes.
AI financing and capex funding needs, plus IPO supply.
Stretched commodity positioning and a large refiner drawdown.
A 'junk' rally reversal and low volumes.
vol_and_positioning: The VIX is 17.58. Sinha suggests protection on earnings-vulnerable (JPUXERNV) and Low Profitable Crowding (JPLPCRW2) baskets.
Quality (JPQPURE) was down 2Z at one point while junk rallied. The spread of TMT Crowding (JP9TCROW) over Low Profitable Crowding (JPLPCRW2) captures the move.
Heavey sees tentative re-risking, with Info Tech the leading buy sector in the room at about 1.25x to 1 and volumes light.
Sentiment is in the Fear region, but positioning has not fully washed out.
Hedge funds lifted bearish euro bets to the most since 2020 (CFTC, via BBG headline).
The Energy CTA signal for diesel and gasoil was firmly long, and positioning in commodities is extended.
geopolitical: Trump is nearing a decision on Iran between negotiation and continued attacks. A third aircraft carrier is nearing the region, and Iran says new bombing would bring strikes on the region, including Israel and the UAE.
Ukraine has not hit Russian energy infrastructure since 10/18, and Russia's overnight attacks avoided power infrastructure, one of Zelensky's three asks.
The one-year US-China trade truce expires Nov 1, with a report that it was extended through Jan 20, 2027.
Honda warns that 50% Canada auto tariffs would be catastrophic.
Midterm elections are Nov 3. Israel's legislative election was Oct 27 and the Brazil runoff Oct 25.
